ana: Quick a11y pass on the 'Run details' modal we shipped in the dashboard. Did a fast sweep with NVDA. Noted: 1) focus lands inside modal but isn't trapped (tab can go to background toolbar). 2) table rows inside the modal lack row headers for SR users, NVDA reads "cell" a lot. 3) the close button is announced only as 'button' sometimes. Screenshot: https://redwood.dev/snip/run-modal-a11y.png devin: Oof, thanks. Can you list the steps to reproduce and NVDA output? ana: Steps: open a run, press tab to focus, NVDA reads: "Dialog" then focus lands on the first cell and says "cell 2 of 4" without context. Repro on Windows + NVDA 2023.2. Expected: focus should move to the dialog container, announce the dialog name like 'Run details dialog' and focus should be trapped inside. priya: Agree on trapping. For dialogs we should have role="dialog" aria-modal="true" and an accessible name via aria-label or aria-labelledby. Also ensure we set inert on the background so screen readers don't navigate outside. mika: Adding: we should programmatically focus a logical element inside (first focusable) and restore focus to the trigger on close. Also important: keyboard shortcut 'Esc' closes the modal but sometimes it closes two layers when the background toast is present. Need to stop propagation when handled. devin: Proposed markup:```html

Run details: build-1342

StepStatus
InstallDone
``` This uses th with scope=row so screen readers get row headings. ana: Nice. Two additional issues: 1) the progress bar inside each row is not textually described; NVDA just sees a div with role progressbar but no aria-valuenow. 2) color-only status chips (green/red) aren't conveying state to colorblind users. priya: For progress: ensure role="progressbar" has aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, aria-valuenow and aria-valuetext when needed. Example: `
`. For chips: add visually-hidden text or `aria-label` on the chip like `aria-label="Status: failed"` and keep color as decoration. devin: On the focus trap: we'll implement a small focus-trap util that adds two sentinels before/after and cycles focus. Also set document.body.inert = true for the background when supported, with a fallback that sets aria-hidden on siblings. accessbot: automated-check: Missing: role="dialog" accessible name; table lacking row headers; progressbar missing aria-valuenow. Contrast warnings: status chip 'success' #6BCB6B on white = 3.9:1. Recommend #2EBD4A for 4.5:1. mika: Small copy/announce tweak: heading 'Run details: build-1342' is verbose for SR. Prefer 'Run details, build 1342' (comma helps SR intonation). Also prefer short labels on chips: 'Done' > 'Completed' for brevity. ana: Also, keyboard nav: inside the table when a row is focused we support arrow keys to move between rows. NVDA users expect arrow key semantics on role="grid" but we implemented as table. Two choices: either keep table and remove arrow-key handlers, or mark as role="grid" and add grid keyboard semantics. Which do we prefer? priya: I vote for keeping semantic table markup and removing custom arrow handlers unless it's strictly required. Tables have browse mode expectations in SR. If we need a selectable list, use role="listbox" or `grid` with proper keyboard handling. devin: Good call. We'll revert the arrow handlers and add a focused row style for keyboard focus. CSS suggestion: ```css .run-row:focus { outline: 3px solid rgba(0,113,188,0.28); outline-offset: 2px; } ``` Make sure we only remove custom handlers where not required. ana: Test plan: after PR: NVDA + Chrome on Windows, VoiceOver + Safari on macOS, and keyboard-only navigation test. I'll run the modal flow and table readout tests. Priya, can you review the aria semantics? priya: Yup. I'll review and add a short checklist to the design doc: dialog name, aria-modal, focus trap, table row headers, progressbar aria, chip aria-label, contrast >=4.5:1, restore focus on close. devin: I'll open PR "modal: run details a11y fixes (dialog, table, progress, focus)" with the changes above, plus unit tests asserting aria attributes and e2e that asserts focus never leaves modal. Link coming shortly. accessbot: automated-check on PR: flagged missing inert fallback and one spec test failing for progressbar aria-valuenow. mika: I'll handle the inert fallback and fix progressbar test. Thanks everyone for the quick sweep. Small changes but big impact for SR/keyboard users.
